title: Prompt asked for tests demonstrating the requirements; ID-based routes (R3-R6) have none
evidence: main_test.go:133 — comment: "We'll skip the ID-based tests for now to avoid URL construction issues". Only 4 tests exist (health, create, create-validation, list); no test exercises ?author=, GET/PUT/DELETE /books/{id}. scores.json test_coverage=0.293.
suggestion: Add table-driven httptest cases calling singleBookHandler via httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/books/1", nil) and a ?author= filter case.

title: Error responses are plain text, not JSON, in a JSON API
evidence: main.go:107-110 http.Error(w, "Title and author are required", 400) writes text/plain; same at main.go:67, 96, 136, 186, 223, 257.
suggestion: Add a writeJSONError(w, code, msg) helper so every response body is JSON with Content-Type: application/json.

title: GET /books encodes an empty collection as null instead of []
evidence: main.go:159 `var books []Book` stays nil when no rows match; main.go:171 json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(books) then emits `null`.
suggestion: Initialize with `books := []Book{}` so the empty case serializes as [].

title: Tests open and then delete the production database file
evidence: main_test.go:15 calls initDB(), which opens ./books.db (main.go:31); main_test.go:21 os.Remove("./books.db") deletes it after the run.
suggestion: Parameterize the DSN (env var or initDB(path)) and point tests at a temp file or file::memory:.

title: rows.Err() is never checked after the row-scan loop
evidence: main.go:160-170 iterates rows.Next() and returns at main.go:171 without checking rows.Err(); a mid-iteration driver error silently yields a truncated 200 response.
suggestion: Check `if err := rows.Err(); err != nil` before encoding the response.

title: ?author= filter does not escape LIKE wildcards
evidence: main.go:146-147 builds `WHERE author LIKE ?` with "%"+author+"%"; an author value containing % or _ is treated as a wildcard.
suggestion: Escape %, _ and \\ in the argument and add ESCAPE '\\', or use instr()/= for exact matching.

title: Unreachable duplicate method guards inside every handler
evidence: main.go:95-98 re-checks r.Method != POST although booksHandler (main.go:61-67) already dispatched on method; same dead branch at main.go:135-138, 176-179, 200-203, 247-250.
suggestion: Drop the inner guards — the dispatchers in booksHandler/singleBookHandler already return 405.

title: Agent aborted on context exhaustion at ~39.7K tokens despite a configured 262144 window
evidence: _agent_stdout.log: "Context length exceeded (39,728 tokens). Cannot compress further."; _effective_stack.json sets context_length=262144, context_threshold=0.9; .hermes_usage.json records completed=false, failed=true (70 api_calls) while _meta.json records succeeded=true.
suggestion: Harness issue, not a model deficiency — the deliverable was complete before the abort (main.go last written 03:18, abort 03:31). Verify the effective context window for exp-64's local cells before trusting the configured 262K.
